label: Matched controls for the practical specification of fixed rational giving (inference)
rule: Evaluate the common rational giving assignment with different practical clause and recognition assignments
meaning: The same fixed rational giving occurs throughout. Coverage fails with apprehension and satisfaction but no operative use. On the operative profiles the same bare production is always required. Changing the two requirements independently tests the rejection premises without changing who gives being. With the full plan fixed, switching off willing or direction for the distinct recipient falsifies the corresponding recognition rule and bridge. The certificate is structural and compares no possible worlds of a metaphysical rival.
